5834.title: File opener registration rejects separator-containing extensions
5834.rootCauseOneLine: The file-opener collector rejects every non-alphanumeric extension although file matching preserves underscore and hyphen separators.
5834.proposedFix: Permit lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by an underscore or hyphen in file-opener registration, document the accepted grammar, and cover registration through file matching with regression tests.
5834.caveats: Direct collector reproduction, repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout; no live frontend or KiCad application was started. Frontend deactivation is supported by source inspection, not a browser run.
